Import.Subtitle: Move your old Excel sheet into the CRM

Import.Rule1: Each marked column (1, x, yes…) becomes a separate activity: Cold Call, Email, Visit, Facility Tour.
Import.Rule2: Notes and original dates are kept exactly; a row with only a note becomes an "Other" activity.
Import.Rule3: Companies that don't exist yet are created automatically.
Import.Rule4: Nothing is saved until you confirm; the import runs in one transaction (all or nothing).
